📌 Government or landlord deciding about a locale from outside it. Five links, sometimes more.
📌 The locale's problem. It is where the chain starts and where it is least able to act.
📌 First station. Local in address, but it does not decide.
📌 Further from the locale, further from the facts.
📌 Written for everywhere, therefore for nowhere in particular.
📌 The deciding link. Outside the locale, unreachable from it, and unable to be re-wired by anyone in it.
📌 The deciding link is not local. Everything below it is a chain it cannot alter.
📌 Adding a liaison or a navigator makes it six links: −1.79. The coordinator is another link, and the deciding link stays exactly as far away.

g.title: 📌 The deciding link brought inside, and the single remote route replaced by several local attempts.
📌 Inside, among them, reachable. The group can name which mode it is in and change it — which is the whole of what participation requires.
📌 Shares the locale but not a training, a livelihood, a network or a class position. That is what keeps the correlation low and the pack strong.
